package_name: Amritsar to Parvati Valley (5D) — Kasol & Hidden Treks

itinerary.day_1: Amritsar → Kasol (Drive: 280 km · 6 hrs). Places: Kasol. Activities: Golden Temple morning darshan; Drive via Chandigarh; Kasol riverside arrival.
itinerary.day_2: Kasol → Malana (Drive: Local + trek). Places: Malana Village, Chalal. Activities: Chalal village walk; Malana ancient democracy village; Return via forest trail.
itinerary.day_3: Kheerganga Trek (Drive: 25 km to Barshaini). Places: Kheerganga Trek. Activities: Drive to Barshaini trailhead; 12km forest trek; Natural hot spring at 2,960m.
itinerary.day_4: Descent & Manikaran (Drive: Return). Places: Manikaran Sahib, Kasol. Activities: Morning descent; Manikaran hot spring langar; Kasol rest evening.
itinerary.day_5: Kasol → Amritsar (Drive: 280 km · 6 hrs). Activities: Kullu market stop; Beas valley drive; Amritsar arrival.
